fields.latestPosition: Previously on hold pending review (21/08). Signed PDF filed 16/09. Waiting for a test period to be arranged by Mech Projects.
fields.nextAction: Review upstream start timing before permanent implementation (18/09).
fields.why: Under the existing control philosophy, 222-SC-002 and 222-SC-502 keep running after a 222-CV-006 process stoppage. A trial interlock with a 2-second off-delay is proposed to see whether it reduces material accumulation in the CV-006 feed chutes.
fields.design:
- 222-SC-002 HPGR Screen 1 – add process interlock: 222-CV-006 HPGR Feed Conveyor Running (2 s delay)
- 222-SC-502 HPGR Screen 2 – add process interlock: 222-CV-006 HPGR Feed Conveyor Running (2 s delay)
- Neither screen currently has start permissives or process interlocks
fields.impact: HPGR screens 1 and 2 will stop about 2 seconds after CV-006 stops instead of continuing to run.
fields.testCriteria:
- Normal operation: screen starts, runs and stops normally from PCS/SCADA
- Process shutdown delay: screen stops ~2 s after 222-CV-006 stops
- Safety shutdown: screen stops immediately with no delay on E-Stop or pull-wire
- Alarm and status verification: no unexpected alarms
- Record Pass/Fail for 222-SC-002 and 222-SC-502 at each step
fields.scheduleNote: Waiting for a test period to be arranged by Mech Projects.
